scripts.build: tsc -b && node scripts/build-icons.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-pwa.mjs && node scripts/build-compressed.mjs && vite build --config vite.worker.config.ts
scripts.build:native: tsc -b && node scripts/build-icons.mjs && vite build --mode native
scripts.native:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync && node scripts/build-native-icons.mjs
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && cap open android
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && cap open ios
